titles.ja: へっぽこ実験アニメーション エクセル・サーガ

title.es: Plan para asesinar a Koshi Rikudo

1.overview: Ilpalazzo desires to exterminate the world's manga artists, ordering Excel to start with Rikdo Koshi, but she is thwarted by the intervention of the Great Will of the Macrocosm and her own conscience. After chatting with Pedro the immigrant worker and chasing down dinner, Excel makes a second attempt on Rikdo's life.
1.summary:
Excel works toward Il Palazzo’s newest goal: the elimination of all comic book artists! In the course of her mission, she dies a few times and rescues a dog that she might eat for dinner.
Source: crunchyroll

title.fr: La femme qui vient de Mars

2.overview: Across has a new rival in its quest for world domination- a Puchuu invasion force from the planet Mars. As the city suffers from a torrential deoluge of rain, only one woman remains energetic and foolish enough to brave the weather and save the world from the Martian invasion- Excel Excel. Armed with her emergency food supply Menchi, Excel may well be the only one able to withstand the Puchuu's greatest weapon- their overwhelming cutenessâ€¦
2.summary:
When an adorable alien invasion force appears in the skies above F City, Excel springs into action! During the chaos, Nabeshin and Space Butler work together for the good of a sleeping princess.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 地獄の毒々大脱走のいけにえ
title.en: The Sacrificial Lamb of the Venomous Great Escape of Hell
title.fr: L`agneau sacrificiel de la grande évasion venimeuse de l`Enfer
title.es: El chivo expiatorio de la gran huida hostil del infierno
title.x-jat: Jigoku no Dokudoku Daidassou no Ikenie

3.overview: Having been captured by guerrillas after accidentally ending up in a war zone, Excel finds herself trapped in the worst torture of all- being part of a B movie action flick! Meanwhile, Ilpallazzo sends Across' newest agent Hyatt to find the missing Excel, but given her tendency to drop dead every few minutes, the search could take longer than anticipatedâ€¦
3.summary:
Deep in the jungle, Excel is held captive by a small army of soldiers.  Il Palazzo sends Hyatt to deal with the situation - and she fails completely. But the guerillas have a bigger problem: Nabeshin!
Source: crunchyroll

4.overview: When Ilpalazzo decides to amuse himself with a handheld dating game, little does he realise that his in-game choices are affecting Watanabe's real life attempts to spend time with his beautiful (if somewhat ill) new neighbour Hyatt! But as the game gets continually tougher and crazier, will Ilpalazzo and Watanabe be able to get a winning â€˜score', or will it all end in a catastrophic game over?
4.summary:
Watanabe wants to get romantic with Hyatt, but he might not have the moves to make it happen - especially when it turns out his moves are actually being controlled by controlled by Il Palazzo!
Source: crunchyroll

5.overview: To find out just how corrupt F City's officials are, Excel and Hyatt are sent to infiltrate City Hall, where they soon find themselves embroiled in a sea of deceitful, underhanded and downright crazy goings-on! But with the help of some Resident Evil-style hints scrawled on the bathroom wall, the duo just might be able to unravel the events going on at City Hall, not to mention add their own brand of chaos to the mixâ€¦
5.summary:
City Hall is in the manipulative clutches of a secret mastermind. Can Excel and Hyatt defeat the dangerous deviant and untangle the web of political corruption? Meanwhile, zombie attack!
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: The Cold Is Winter! Snowed Under Episode
title.es: El frio es invierno! Un episodio cubierto de nieve
title.x-jat: Samu ga Fuyui ze!! Sounan Hen

6.overview: When Ilpalazzo sends Excel and Hyatt on a mission to gather more resources for Across, the duo find themselves journeying out to the mountains. However, whether it's panning for gold or hunting for meat, finding resources in the middle of a survival drama setting promises to be far from an easy task for our intrepid heroines! And elsewhere, Watanabe, Iwata and Sumiyoshi face trials of their own as they attend a bizarre training seminar and meet up with a new colleague- the beautiful and dangerous Misaki Matsuya.
6.summary:
Wandering within a snowy mountain range, the gang struggles to survive! As Excel and Hyatt hunt for food, Iwata, Watanabe, and Sumiyoshi familiarize themselves with some high-powered laser guns.
Source: crunchyroll

7.overview: When Kabapu sends Watanabe and his colleagues to investigate the sewers surrounding the Across base, Ilpalazzo dispatches Excel and Hyatt to deal with the intruders. However, even as the duo familiarise themselves with the Across security system, they discover a far more sinister breed of intruders lurking in the sewers- an army of Puchuus led by the nefarious Puchuu Queen! Will Excel and the others be able to stand against this overwhelming cute force of evil?
7.summary:
Horror lurks in the slimy tunnels beneath the city! As Excel and the gang navigate the dark corridors, hordes of adorable aliens prepare to pounce. Can their monstrous alien queen be stopped before she gives birth to an army?
Source: crunchyroll

title.es: Semana de aumento del índice de audiencia

8.overview: It's an all-girl fan service fest as Excel and Hyatt take off to the swimming pool, accompanied by local girl Cosette. But even as they laze in the sun and enjoy all the clichÃ©s of a summer episode, it appears that Cosette may have a deadlier mission in mind than simply taking a quick dip in the pool. Could such a cute little girl really be a sinister assassin? On a show like this, anything seems likelyâ€¦
8.summary:
Today’s episode of Excel Saga is a desperate grab for ratings, and you know what that means: A swimming pool full of bouncing babes in barely-there bikinis!
Source: crunchyroll

9.overview: When Ilpalazzo orders Excel and Hyatt to learn how to control the masses through their most popular sports, the duo end up working in the rather less than mainstream field of ten pin bowling! However, what looks to be nothing more than a quiet part time job in a bowling alley soon becomes far more dangerous when the alley is taken over by an evil terrorist group of middle-aged bowling fanatics! Now only woman stands in the way of these miscreants- the over-energetic yet under-competent Excel Excelâ€¦
9.summary:
Excel and Hyatt head to the bowling alley after Il Palazzo suggests using sports as a tool to further his agenda. Unfortunately, the plan might end up in the gutter when terrorists strike. Get it? Gutter? Strike? Bowling!
Source: crunchyroll

10.overview: When the stress of life as an emergency food supply becomes too much for Menchi, she takes the first opportunity she can to escape from Excel's apartment and go in search of her former owner, a kindly old man. Life on the streets soon proves quite tough for the little dog, however, but fortunately help is at hand when she meets up with a disparate gang of dogs all conforming to well-known movie stereotypes. With her new friends by her side, Menchi continues her quest for the old man, but in typical fashion, danger and betrayal are lurking around every cornerâ€¦
10.summary:
After escaping Excel’s hungry clutches, Menchi begins searching for her previous owner. Unfortunately, the little dog goes straight from the frying pan and into the fire when she starts running with a pack of strays.
Source: crunchyroll

11.overview: Thanks to the state of modern education, the future is looking bleak- and that means that Across must take action. To that end, Ilpalazzo sends Excel and Hyatt to work at Excel's old high school, which has since become a dumping ground for all manner of juvenile delinquents. But no sooner have they tamed the students than a new challenge arises- whipping the school's woefully poor baseball team back into shape. But even with all the clichÃ©s of sports anime on their side, will Excel and Hyatt be able to create a team good enough to win their crucial match against the Monkey Balls High team?
11.summary:
Excel’s old high school is overrun by troublemakers and thugs. She and Hyatt quickly straighten the delinquents out, but they might swing and miss on the next mission: turning the school’s pitiful baseball team into winners!
Source: crunchyroll

12.overview: Having decided that his employees need some additional training, Kabapu sends Watanabe and the others to train under Purin, a detective who can turn from a tough-as-nails old-timer into a cute girl quite literally at the drop of a hat! And whilst they tag along for Purin's latest case, Excel has some problem solving of her own to do when Hyatt is taken hostage by a pair of burglars.
12.summary:
It’s time for a crime-ridden tale of revenge set on the dirty city streets. Veteran detective Purin’s tough exterior hides a secret, and while the gang works with the gumshoe, Excel has to save Hyatt from a couple of crooks.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 新春年忘れかくし芸大会
title.en: The New Year`s Year-End Party Hidden Talent Contest
title.es: La fiesta de año nuevo del fin de año del concurso de talentos ocultos

13.overview: It had to happen eventually. The producers got behind schedule- there's way no way enough material for a whole new show could be produced in time. So what plan than to polish off some old clips, do some fancy editing, and make up a review episode? Yes, it's Excel Saga's turn for a clip show, framed by a seasonal New Year-Year's End Hidden Talent Content, as presented by Excel and Hyatt.
13.summary:
It’s a star-studded New Year’s recap episode featuring a talent competition between Excel and Hyatt. Sit back and enjoy all of your favorite moments from the first twelve installments of Excel Saga.
Source: crunchyroll

14.overview: In order to pick up flagging ratings, the Excel Saga writers introduce a new character: the android lady Ropponmatsu, creation of Dr. Shioji, a brilliant scientist with a mostly-innocent (thank goodness) fixation with small girls. Iwata, of course, becomes hopelessly enamored with Ropponmatsu, completely clueless to the fact that she's not a living, breathing human. Meanwhile, Excel and Hyatt manage to bungle a seemingly simple mission to deliver a package with a bomb in it, one discovered and disarmed by Ropponmatsu... well, not quite, much to Iwata's horror.
14.summary:
The ratings are floundering once again, so it’s time to introduce another new character: Ropponmatsu, a robotic cutie with a knack for defusing bombs. Unfortunately, that’s bad news for Excel - she’s planning to blow up City Hall!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: もっと! てこいれメモリアル

15.overview: Annoyed that Ropponmatsu has bought it after only one episode, the merchandising team demands that she be put back in the show immediately. In the meantime, Iwata tries to put up with Ropponmatsu 2, an annoyingly cute little-girl version of the original Ropponmatsu, and Excel and Hyatt try their last mission over again, this time with a robot of their own!
15.summary:
There’s a new Ropponmatsu on the scene, and while she’s way more annoying than the previous model, she’s just in time to stop Il Palazzo’s newest explosive plot - a plot that involves Excel in a panda costume.
Source: crunchyroll

16.overview: After getting demolished again in the last episode, new copies of Ropponmatsu 1 and 2 are delivered to Watanabe's apartment. But by mistake, Excel and Hyatt accidentally activate the new models, which immediately become fixated with them, in more ways than one! But will this double dose of shoujo-ai end in tragedy... or just dark comedy?
16.summary:
It’s hard to keep a good Ropponmatsu down! Both models have returned, and this time they find themselves developing feelings for Excel and Hyatt, thanks to some sketchy programming.
Source: crunchyroll

17.overview: On a mission to investigate the situation in America, Excel and Hyatt run into a band of street thugs... and a communication problem. Fortunately, they get some help from Sandora, the son of Excel's late friend Pedro, who is working as a cel animator to support his mother. But it seems these cels are being hoarded by an evil gangster, who quickly gets a hard lesson in the rules of cartoon heroics by an outraged Excel.
17.summary:
After Excel and Hyatt arrive in America, their recon mission is derailed by Excel’s not-so-hot grasp of English. And when the girls find themselves tangling with the Mafia, they’re forced to unleash some epic cartoon violence.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 市立戦隊ダイテンジン
title.fr: Daitenjin, les guerriers de la mairie

18.overview: Desperate for more material, the writers of ""Excel Saga"" take a page or two from Koshi Rikdou's old ""masked heroes"" parody Daitenjin, and have our hapless heroes in the Safety Assurance Agency (Watanabe, Iwata, Sumiyoshi, Matsuya, and both Ropponmatsus) made into the Municipal Force Daitenjin, against their will no less. In order to get out of the rather uncomfortable jumpsuits, the team goes about finding and dealing with all the terrible crimes (or not-so-terrible ones) they can find.
18.summary:
Watanabe’s gang is forced to suit up as a squad of high-tech, masked crime-fighters to keep the streets safe. Unfortunately, city-wide destruction might be inevitable, thanks to the explosive power of their new costumes.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: メンチの大冒険2 ~80時間世界一周~
title.en: Menchi`s Great Adventure 2: Around the World in 80 Hours
title.fr: Le tour du monde en 80 heures
title.es: La gran aventura de Menchi 2 ~La vuelta al mundo en 80 horas~

19.overview: Menchi makes another break while Excel and Hyatt are out of town on a mission, and ends up on a boat to America. There, she meets Ann Anzai, a young lady who must travel the world in 80 hours before she can collect her inheritance from her grandfather, and accompanies the girl on her adventure. Can the two of them make it in time, and can Menchi defend her new friend from a mysterious assassin out to get both of them?
19.summary:
Menchi sails to the United States, where she undertakes an around-the-world adventure with a young heiress. The journey won’t be easy - there’s a deadly assassin on their tail!
Source: crunchyroll

20.overview: Having charted the misadventures of Pedro, as he struggled for a season and a half to return home to his son and his sexy wife, the writers of Excel Saga have Excel and Hyatt sitting around in a bar and recapping Pedro's escapades. Yep, it's another clip show... but with a twist, as new footage is revealed showing the return of Nabeshin, and the kidnapping of the Great Will of the Macrocosm and Pedro's wife by the evil That Man!
20.summary:
The time has arrived to reflect on all that Pedro has endured. But this isn’t an ordinary recap show; there’s plenty of new stuff, too, including the reappearance of Nabeshin!
Source: crunchyroll

21.overview: Fed up with Ilpalazzo's lack of progress, ACROSS HQ sends the leather-clad, ruggedly handsome, and more-bishonen-than-thou agent Key to deliver an important message to Ilpalazzo. But rock-star wanabee Key, being the ""artise"" that he is, won't deliver his little singing telegram until his muse returns. In the meantime, an envious Ilpalazzo sends the lovestruck Excel and the blasÃ¨-as-usual Hyatt to keep an eye on Key.    That's easier said than done, though, as Key hooks up with a down-on-their-luck ""visual-type"" band and turns them into superstars, even scoring them a big gig, where he plans to reveal his big message on national television...
21.summary:
The big-wigs at ACROSS send a rock n’ roller named Key to give a message to Il Palazzo. Key wants to deliver the information in a song, but first he must find the proper inspiration. Can Excel motivate him to complete his mission?
Source: crunchyroll

22.overview: Having finally gotten the hint from ACROSS that he should hurry up the whole invasion thing, Ilpalazzo orders Hyatt to perform final preparations for the conquest of the city of ""F"", and orders the bungling Excel to keep her nose out of it.    Excel has no time to be dejected, though: the Puchuus have returned, and she and Hyatt must help a band of freedom fighters thwart the machinations of an evil conqueror and his really big spaceship! But even after our favorite ACROSS agents defeat the invaders and destroy their ship, the city of ""F"" gets squashed by the falling debris. Well, them's the breaks...
22.summary:
After so many missteps, it appears Il Palazzo might finally succeed in conquering the city! There’s only one final obstacle: a war between rival Puchuu factions could destroy the place before ACROSS can take it over.
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: Legend of the End of the Century Conqueror
title.es: La leyenda del conquistador de final de siglo

23.overview: We find Excel wandering the wasteland that once was ""F"" City, where she becomes entangled in a conflict between a settlement of survivors and a band of maraudering raiders. After fending off the thugs with her ""ACROSS Martial Arts"" (which involves beating the opponent in the right places 'til they turn into a Digi Charat character), Excel finally finds her beloved Ilpalazzo... only for him to strike her down callously. Without the Great Will to ressurect her, can the mortally wounded Excel survive? (She'd better, the series isn't over yet!)
23.summary:
A great city is now a wasteland, and the remnants of humanity struggle to survive a rising tide of violence and anarchy. Within the rubble of civilization, there is but one hope for the future. Unfortunately, it’s Excel!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: きみのためなら死ねる

24.overview: After Koshi Rikdo declares this episode to be gag-free, an amnesiac Excel gives the performance of her life after being rescued by the surviving members of the Safety Assurance Agency (i.e. all of them). But as she copes with her betrayal and tries to recover her identity, Ilpalazzo is having an identity crisis of his own, as his drive to conquer pushes him further forward. Angst and pointless plot twists abound as Excel searches for ACROSS... and Ilpalazzo struggles with his ambition.
24.summary:
Stricken with a case of amnesia in the aftermath of her devastating encounter with Il Palazzo, Excel must fight to remember her forgotten past - and find a way to make her former boss pay for his betrayal.
Source: crunchyroll

title.en: We Will Not Be Held Responsible

25.overview: Fed up with the insanity, Koshi Rikdo finally insists that the animation and writing crew finish the freaking series already. So, the Safety Assurance Agency locks horns with ACROSS, Excel tracks down Ilpalazzo and beats some sense into him, Watanabe finally realizes the truth about Hyatt, and the series finally comes to an end... or does it?
25.summary:
Koshi Rikdo tells the Excel Saga production team to wrap it up! With the series coming to an end, Watanabe finally makes his move on Hyatt, and Excel prepares for her climactic confrontation with Il Palazzo!
Source: crunchyroll

S1.summary:
Prepare to witness the most over-the-top insanity ever. This very special episode of Excel Saga doesn’t cross the line of decency. No, this episode gleefully stomps the line of decency into a disgusting, oozing pulp!
Source: crunchyroll
